root_cause: Powerhouse had detailed runtime, delivery, learning and evidence mechanisms, but no single human-facing cockpit that combined AI/chat/agent activity, GitHub delivery, errors, system layers, documentation, learning and skill projection into one daily filterable view. This forced operators to reconstruct system truth from separate pages and tools.
prevention_rule: Project observability from the existing canonical brain-operating-loop authority into one read-only Portal V2 cockpit. Never create a second operational truth store for dashboard convenience. Every metric must derive from runtime evidence; missing evidence remains unknown/empty. Keep filters and drill-down client-side over the canonical projection, and extend the projection rather than duplicating business logic.
